mapper.select: select to_char(a.at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') at, a.actor, a.action, a.detail::text detail from audit_log a where a.tenant_id = #{tid} order by a.at desc limit 200
select sid, lp::text lp from learner_progress where tenant_id = #{tid} order by updated_at desc limit 5000
select pw from users where id = cast(#{uid} as uuid)
